content.user_title: Build Bazel Mobile Apps on Limrun
content.value_statement: Mobile Bazel builds require compatible workers, toolchains, and reliable authentication. This skill guides Limrun setup, remote builds, CI authentication, and installation on cloud simulators or emulators.
actual_capabilities: Guide npm CLI installation and authentication through lim login or LIM_API_KEY.
Configure eligible Bazel workspaces with lim bazel setup and identify missing Android module dependencies.
Guide remote target builds using the Limrun configuration and persistent user build flags.
Describe noninteractive CI setup using secret authentication and accepted dependency additions.
Guide installation of built apps on Limrun iOS simulators and Android emulators.
Troubleshoot credential helpers, worker capacity, toolchain dependencies, and regional cache behavior.
limitations: Requires Bazel 8 or later, a root MODULE.bazel, and rules_apple or rules_android.
Requires Limrun access and the npm CLI installation, version 0.44.0 or later, for the credential helper.
Provides instructions only; external CLI, worker, and credential helper implementations are not included.
Does not cover non-Bazel Android builds, legacy Xcode remote execution, or interactive app control.

prompt_templates.title: Check workspace readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this Bazel mobile workspace meets Limrun prerequisites. Report missing requirements and propose setup steps before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Build and install an app
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure Limrun for my Bazel target [target]. Build for [iOS simulator or Android emulator], then install the output on the matching Limrun instance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: build and run a mobile app

prompt_templates.title: Prepare CI setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare Limrun CI steps for [target]. Use secret authentication, review proposed module additions, and explain noninteractive setup without exposing credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a remote build failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this Limrun Bazel error: [error]. Check helper availability, authentication presence, dependencies, worker capacity, and regional cache behavior without printing secrets.

output_examples.input: What should I check before enabling Limrun for this Android Bazel workspace?
output: Confirm Bazel 8 or later and Android rules in the root module.
Install the npm CLI and ensure the credential helper is available.
Review missing Android toolchain dependencies before accepting setup changes.
Enable the Limrun configuration for the selected target.

output_examples.input: My remote build reports a credential helper error.
output: Check that the npm installation provides the credential helper on PATH.
Confirm login authentication or the API key is available where Bazel runs, without displaying its value.
A key passed only through the CLI flag is not a supported helper credential source.

output_examples.input: Why did the first build slow down after changing regions?
output_examples.output: Each region has its own cache. The first build in a new region starts cold; inspect the console cache hit rate.

best_practices: Keep API keys in CI secret storage and check authentication presence without printing credential values.
Review dependency additions before using noninteractive setup; inspect workspace changes after setup.
Store custom flags in user.limrun.bazelrc and rerun setup after CLI upgrades or mobile rule changes.
anti_patterns: Hand-editing generated files in .limrun instead of using setup or the user configuration file.
Assuming a standalone CLI installation or an API key flag provides Bazel helper authentication.
Assuming remote cache contents are shared across regions or omitting the Limrun build configuration.

faq.question: Which workspaces are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow requires Bazel 8 or later, a root MODULE.bazel, and rules_apple or rules_android.

faq.question: How does Bazel authenticate?
faq.answer: The npm installation provides lim-bazel-credentials. It uses lim login or LIM_API_KEY to obtain short-lived tokens.

faq.question: Does setup modify my workspace?
faq.answer: Setup creates a gitignored .limrun directory and updates .bazelrc. It asks before adding missing Android dependencies unless you use the yes flag.

faq.question: Can I use this workflow in CI?
faq.answer: Yes. Install the npm CLI, provide LIM_API_KEY through secret storage, run noninteractive setup, and build with the Limrun configuration.

faq.question: Where should custom build flags go?
faq.answer: Put them in user.limrun.bazelrc at the workspace root. The generated configuration imports this file last and preserves it during setup.

faq.question: Do all regions share the same cache?
faq.answer: No. Each region maintains its own cache, so the first build after changing regions starts cold.
